MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (p)-[pf:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.college = 'Michigan State University'
  AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) > 1964
    OR (
      CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) = 1964
      AND (
        CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10
        OR (
          CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10
          AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) >= 14
        )
      )
    )
  )
  AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) <= 2026
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.college = 'Michigan State University'

  AND (
    CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) < 1964
    OR (
      CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) = 1964
      AND (
        CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) < 10
        OR (
          CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10
          AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) <= 14
        )
      )
    )
  )
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
